$comment: Per-character animation overrides — the canonical source of truth for which character-baked GLB plays for each AnimName slot. Maintained by scripts/mixamo/add-anim-everywhere.ts and scripts/mixamo/fetch-animations.ts; safe to edit by hand. Schema: { <animatorId>: { <AnimName>: '<url-path-to-glb>', ... }, ... }. animatorId matches the second arg of `new VRMCharacterAnimator(vrm, animatorId)`. Slot keys must match the AnimName type in vrm-character-animator.ts.

hermes-male.$comment: NO 'walk' key INTENTIONALLY: hermes-male (and Phanes, the default Hatcher avatar, which animates via animatorId 'hermes-male') uses the clean GLOBAL walk.glb (net -0.845 hips-Y, mostly cyclic). The per-character public/avatars/animations/hermes-male/walk.glb on disk is the OLD broken bake (+1.887 hips-Y drift/loop, dropped in commit 8fd93b32) — do NOT wire it as a 'walk' override here without verifying it plays in-place; PER_CHARACTER_IN_PLACE_CLIPS['hermes-male'] already lists 'walk' defensively so wiring it would strip positions and stay sink-safe. (Hatcher review FIX-15 / 3D-5.) Note: this $-prefixed key is inert — the loader only ever indexes this object by AnimName, never '$comment'.

adinero.$comment: Adinero uses GLOBAL clips for idle/walk/run — no per-character Mixamo bakes exist for this rig yet. The global clips have Mixamo-standard hips at Y≈95-102, so hipsPositionScale = vrmHipsHeight(≈0.82m) / motionHipsHeight(≈101) ≈ 0.008 — essentially zero, but non-zero. PER_CHARACTER_IN_PLACE_CLIPS['adinero'] strips all three position tracks so foot placement is governed solely by FK rest-pose (feet at Y=0 per VRM 1.0 spec) and the rotation-only retarget. Note: this $-prefixed key is inert (loader keys by AnimName only). If Meshy-baked locomotion clips are produced for this rig in the future, wire them here — PER_CHARACTER_IN_PLACE_CLIPS['adinero'] already has all three stripped defensively.

biggie.$comment: Biggie (2026-07-22) — same Meshy VRM 1.0 rig class as Adinero, same treatment: GLOBAL clips for idle/walk/run via fallback, PER_CHARACTER_IN_PLACE_CLIPS['biggie'] strips all three position tracks so the FK rest-pose governs foot placement. Meshy-native clips for this rig exist on disk at public/models/biggie-mesh/meshy-openai/anim/*.glb but target RAW bone names (native-Meshy animator mode, still unwired) — do NOT wire them here as Mixamo-retarget overrides.
